 {'economic_period':'2024M04','fixed_original_quarter':'2024Q1','observation_date':'2024-03-31','cutoff':'2024-05-27T16:00:00+08:00'}]

 p=old/'quarterly_fact_records_v1_1'/(c['fixed_original_quarter']+'.json')

 'actual_original_pdf_path':str(pdf).replace('\\','/'),'actual_original_pdf_sha256':sha(pdf),

 'historical_first_vintage_authenticated':False})

 'budget':{'local_original_PDFs':3,'local_original_catalog_receipt_chain_only':True,'external_queries':0,'new_raw_GETs':0,'authenticated_requests':0,'request_retries':0},
